title: AgentHop: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Agentic Multi-Hop Question Answering over Scientific Citation Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2609.34428v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Agentic tasks require a large language model to interact with the world, navigating information and gathering evidence across multiple steps with restricted resources. Due to this complexity, agentic task failures arise from various sources, and pinpointing these failure causes is essential to diagnose and improve agentic systems. Existing benchmarks, however, tend to focus on a single leaderboard score, leaving the underlying failure modes opaque. To fill this gap, we introduce AgentHop, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,011 multiple-choice questions paired with a controlled seven-tool sandbox under fixed token, turn, and tool-call constraints. AgentHop reveals model vulnerabilities by dissecting a single accuracy score along four axes of agent operation: retrieval, synthesis, tool-call, and resource management. Across 19 models, we find that behavior clusters by model family, with tool-call signatures revealing distinct family fingerprin

translated_title: AgentHop：面向科学引文图谱上智能体多跳问答的诊断性基准
translated_abstract: 智能体任务要求大型语言模型与世界进行交互，在资源受限的条件下跨多个步骤导航信息并收集证据。由于这种复杂性，智能体任务的失败可能源于多种原因，而精确定位这些失败原因对于诊断和改进智能体系统至关重要。然而，现有的基准测试往往只关注单一的排行榜分数，使底层的失败模式难以被理解。为填补这一空白，我们提出了AgentHop，一个包含1,011道多选题的诊断性基准，并配套一个受控的七工具沙箱，在固定的token数量、对话轮次和工具调用次数约束下运行。AgentHop通过沿智能体运行的四个维度——检索、综合、工具调用和资源管理——剖析单一的准确率分数，从而揭示模型的薄弱环节。在对19个模型的评估中，我们发现模型行为按模型家族聚类，工具调用特征展现出独特的家族指纹。
tldr: AgentHop是一个诊断性基准，通过在受控七工具沙箱中沿检索、综合、工具调用和资源管理四个维度剖析智能体在科学引文图谱上的多跳问答表现，精准定位大语言模型智能体的失败原因。
en_tdlr: AgentHop is a diagnostic benchmark that pinpoints LLM agent failure causes by dissecting agentic multi-hop QA performance over scientific citation graphs along four axes—retrieval, synthesis, tool-call, and resource management—within a controlled seven-tool sandbox.
